method.F_frequency: Uniform measure on the seven listed frequency points, mass1/7 each. F(t)=count(Q_nu<=t)/7, deterministic finite-point CDF, no sky occupancy or probability calibration.
method.Q: Q_nu=norm(c_nu/1e-5 K_CMB), declared computational Euclidean image only. Preserve all24 data alongside it.
method.STF_tolerance: Existing carrier decode consistency rtol1e-9,atol1e-12 K_CMB; no new mathematical certificate implied.
method.carrier: Stack seven signed24 vectors in ascending frequency; retain complete STF rank2/rank3 E and B tensors.
method.conditioning_failure: Retain full carrier/targets with ANCHOR_FIT_ILL_CONDITIONED; omit unjustified predictions. Never change anchors, threshold or weights to obtain fit status.
method.contrasts: d_nu = c_nu-c_143 for six non143 frequencies, all24 coordinates. These are 143-relative contrasts, not proven CMB-cleaned signals.
method.fit: Unweighted E-only least squares alpha_nu=argmin ||d_nu_E-A_E alpha||_2; singular values and s2/s1 retained. If s2/s1>1e-8, calculate A_B alpha and d_nu_B-A_B alpha, all12 signed coordinates.
method.heldout_meaning: Target B does not choose coefficients. This is algorithmic E-to-B holdout, not statistically independent validation: mask E/B leakage and cross-frequency/noise dependence remain unmodelled.
method.numerical_control_tolerance: Preserve existing comparison tolerance1e-12+1e-9*abs(c_j); recorded reduction-only bounds <= tolerance/8 are partial arithmetic diagnostics, excluding harmonic/libm/measurement error.
method.source: Call the exact sealed full7_math.py crossprediction and computational_frequency_image, retaining its formulas and 1e-8 conditioning threshold; explicit import-path/hash verification. Decode using the existing sealed STF decoder.
